text:
Maya Patel: quick find 1: batching.md still shows global kv_prefetch + old flat SDK example. ill open a tiny PR to switch to route-scoped caching, add short-seq guidance, and include short py/go snippets. link after i open it.
Alex Chen: please show concrete numbers for <64 token sequences and recommend short_seq_mode + max_batch_tokens example. folks keep hitting defaults.
Maya Patel: draft python snippet in PR body:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
client.optimize.update_route_config("chat-route", {
  "batching": {"max_batch_tokens": 768, "short_seq_mode": True},
  "caching": {"kv_prefetch": {"enabled": True, "prefix_cache_size": 256}}
})
```
Jordan Rivera: note: python SDK uses update_route_config in v0.8+, good. ensure kv_prefetch is under caching (it is). add a one-line migration tip about avoiding global prefetch to stop cross-route evictions.
Maya Patel: added migration bullet: "Migrate global kv_prefetch to route-scoped caching to avoid cross-route evictions and cache churn."
Samir Gupta: can you add compact Go example for dedicated/private users (streaming hint would help).
Maya Patel: added Go snippet:
```go
import "github.com/redwood/inference/sdk"
client := sdk.NewClient()
cfg := sdk.RouteConfig{
  Batching: sdk.Batching{MaxBatchTokens: 768, ShortSeqMode: true},
  Caching: sdk.Caching{KVPrefetch: sdk.KVPrefetch{Enabled: true, PrefixCacheSize: 256}},
}
client.UpdateRouteConfig("chat-route", cfg)
```
DocsBot: docs-pr-checker: running link + anchor audit for PR (anchors + redirects).
Alex Chen: add fallback quant profile note: recommend `qprofile: balanced-16bit` when routing to cheaper fallbacks to reduce hallucination regressions. one short sentence.
Jordan Rivera: suggest adding an empirical p95 note: short_seq_mode cut p95 by ~30% in our internal benchmark for sequences <64 tokens. helps readers set expectations.
Maya Patel: updated PR with quant note, p95 stat, fixed the broken `#kv-prefetch` anchor by adding a redirect and renaming to `#kv-prefetch-route`. CI/link-check passed. merged with changelog: `docs: replace global prefetch example with route-scoped caching; add short-seq guidance and py/go snippets; add fallback quant note; fix kv-prefetch anchor`
